messages:
ada: Heads-up: embedding store background index rewrite jobs started throttling IO in apac-edge around 07:42 UTC. We're seeing elevated read tail latency and some 503s for embeddings reads. Opening an incident thread. Status: https://status.redwood.in/incident/2999999999

ops-bot: Alert: embed-index-io-throttle.apac (alert_id=embed-io-29999)

oncall-sre: Investigating. Initial signal: disk io saturation on embed-store-primary-apac-1 during scheduled index-rewrite window. Top ops: heavy compaction + rewrite concurrently. Collecting iostat and object-store metrics.

yusuf: Can we pause rewrite jobs and shift read traffic to replica nodes while we stabilize? I'll pause rewrites: `curl -XPOST https://infra-api/internal/jobs/pause?job=index-rewrite&region=apac`

monica: Paused at 07:47 UTC. Also enabling read-only failover to embedding-replica-set-2 for apac region. Command: `traffic-router promote --region apac --service embed-read --to replica-set-2 --pct 100`

ada: Noted (typo correction) — ada: Thanks @yusuf @monica. Posting interim status to status page and pinging top impacted accounts. Draft: "We observed elevated embedding read latency and intermittent 503s in APAC due to background index rewrite jobs causing IO contention. We paused rewrites and redirected reads to replicas; mitigations applied."

ops-bot: Metric update: embed.read.5xx.apac 07:46: 1.6% -> 07:55: 0.05% | embed.read.p95.apac 07:46: 980ms -> 07:55: 210ms

oncall-sre: After failover, read errors dropped quickly but some replica nodes showed CPU spikes from increased QPS. I'm scaling replica set by +3 nodes. Command: `kubectl scale statefulset/embed-replica -n storage --replicas=6`

yusuf: Scaling triggered at 07:58 UTC. Also raised kernel file-descriptor limit on replica nodes to avoid ephemeral fd exhaustion during peak. Script: `ansible -i apac.nodes apply -m shell -a 'ulimit -n 65536'`

monica: Customer impact list (anonymized): AP-CUST-9, AP-CUST-112. Account teams notified. Status page updated with timeline and mitigation steps.

oncall-sre: Root cause hypothesis: compaction/rewrite scheduling allowed heavyweight index writes to collide with peak read windows. Long-term fix: make rewrite jobs IO-aware and schedule during low-read windows; add backpressure to compaction. Owner: yusuf.

ops-bot: Incident labels: severity=sev3, region=apac, product=embed-store, impact=partial, start_ts=2999999999

ad a: small correction: btw, embedding writes unaffected; only read path saw transient 503s.

yusuf: Plan: 1) Resume rewrites at low-traffic window with io-slo=50mb/s; 2) Add scheduler change to throttle rewrites when read p95 > 300ms; 3) Postmortem and follow-up ticket. ETA for full resolution and verification: 6 hours.

monica: I'm drafting the customer-facing note and will attach the list of affected API keys to the ticket for account teams to review.

oncall-sre: Monitoring shows stable reads for 30m after mitigation. I'll leave thread open for 1 hour then mark resolved if no regressions. :white_check_mark:
